text: Third time trying to get through. Grandson is 3. He bumped his head on the coffee table about an hour ago, cried straight away, then was back to himself, running about, completely normal. Wide awake now, chatting and watching his cartoons, no problem waking him earlier either. But I think his crying since then sounds wrong. When he does cry it's thin and squeaky, not his usual big howl, and it goes on and on. And he's gone a funny pale colour, sort of mottled on his arms and legs, lips look pale too I'd say. Temp is 37.6. His mother says I'm fussing but I'm not sure. Somebody please get back to me.
